title: Storage reservation request (what a plugin asks the host for before it writes)
description: A plugin never receives a volume, only a lease: it names itself, a reservable zone, how many bytes it intends to write and why, and the host answers with a lease (`c9-storage-lease`) or a refusal. The zones listed here are the only ones a plugin may ask for; profiles, databases and security logs are never reservable. Provisional: written by the Rust host (phase 2), no TypeScript or Python producer yet.

plugin.description: The plugin's id: lowercase, no separator, no path.
